2609.00242.title: CoLT-Drive: Counterfactual Long-Tail Benchmarking and Knowledge-Preserving Adaptation for Driving Affordance Prediction
2609.00242.paper_summary: Long-tail autonomous driving failures are often framed as rare-object recognition errors. We argue that this view is incomplete: the decision-critical question is not only whether a model recognizes an unusual object, but whether it infers how that object changes the ego vehicle's feasible high-level actions. We formalize this problem as decision-level driving affordance prediction, where a model maps a front-view image, ego-motion history, and navigation command to a structured longitudinal--lateral meta-action. To evaluate this capability, we introduce CoLT-Drive, a 3,536-sample counterfactual long-tail benchmark that inserts rare objects into otherwise fixed driving scenes and measures whether models predict acceptable action pairs. To improve deployable small VLMs, we propose KPA, a knowledge-preserving adaptation framework that combines structured perception-to-decision prompting, SLERP-based expert merging, and RegMoE, a regime-aware LoRA mixture-of-experts module. KPA preserves the pretrained model's open-world knowledge while allocating lightweight adaptation capacity to different driving decision regimes. Experiments on an in-domain driving split and CoLT-Drive show that KPA achieves 60.8\% pair accuracy on CoLT-Drive, outperforming the pretrained Qwen3-VL-2B baseline (50.3\%) and LoRA SFT (32.4\%) while maintaining competitive in-domain accuracy. Our benchmark and code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/tangzx2024/CoLT-Drive and https://github.com/tangzhengxu/CoLT-Drive.
2609.00242.paper_summary_zh: 長尾自動駕駛失敗通常被視為稀有物體識別錯誤。<lb/>我們認為這種看法是不完整的：決策關鍵問題不僅在於模型是否識別出不尋常的物體，而在於它是否推斷出該物體如何改變自我車輛的可行高層次行動。<lb/>我們將這個問題形式化為決策層級的駕駛可行性預測，其中模型將前視圖像、自我運動歷史和導航命令映射到結構化的縱向-橫向元行動。<lb/>為了評估這一能力，我們引入了CoLT-Drive，一個包含3,536個樣本的反事實長尾基準，該基準將稀有物體插入到其他固定駕駛場景中，並測量模型是否預測出可接受的行動對。<lb/>為了改進可部署的小型VLM，我們提出了KPA，一個知識保留適應框架，結合了結構化的感知到決策提示、基於SLERP的專家合併和RegMoE，一個對環境敏感的LoRA專家混合模塊。<lb/>KPA保留了預訓練模型的開放世界知識，同時將輕量級的適應能力分配給不同的駕駛決策範疇。<lb/>在域內駕駛分割和CoLT-Drive上的實驗顯示，KPA在CoLT-Drive上達到了60.8%的配對準確率，超越了預訓練的Qwen3-VL-2B基準（50.3%）和LoRA SFT（32.4%），同時保持了競爭性的域內準確率。<lb/>我們的基準和代碼可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/tangzx2024/CoLT-Drive和https://github.com/tangzhengxu/CoLT-Drive上獲得。
